question: Does Lorentzian Classification provide causal after-cost edge at the higher-frequency M15, M30, or H1 horizons suggested by TradingView, and does it add value beyond Euclidean KNN, momentum, and kernel-only controls?
relationship_to_v1: New hypothesis prompted by observed TradingView signal frequency; v1 H4 results remain immutable and cannot be pooled into v2

official_recent_diagnostic.role: Replicate the short recent-window behavior represented by TradingView trade stats; cannot satisfy the multi-year promotion gate

full_history_variants.causal_lorentzian: Exact rolling 8-NN, Lorentzian distance, feature at j labelled by close j to j+4 and eligible only from j+4
full_history_variants.causal_euclidean: Identical causal KNN with Euclidean distance
full_history_variants.simple_momentum4: Sign of known prior four-bar return with identical filters
full_history_variants.filter_only_kernel: Kernel-slope direction with identical volatility and regime filters and no classifier

candidate_spacing: Historical candidate j is eligible when j modulo 4 is nonzero, matching the pinned source condition

execution.exit: next open after four signal bars, or next open after an earlier qualified opposite start
execution.overlap: one position at a time; direct opposite flip allowed at one shared execution open
execution.end_of_sample: exclude positions without an executable exit

primary_m30_promotion_gate: causal Lorentzian base-cost net bps positive and PF at least 1.10 on both assets
causal Lorentzian exceeds causal Euclidean, simple momentum4, and filter-only kernel net bps on both assets
causal Lorentzian has at least 500 trades per asset
all three frozen year blocks positive on both assets
net bps remains positive after removing ten best trades on both assets
monthly-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound exceeds zero on both assets
stress-cost net bps remains positive on both assets
same-window random-direction one-sided p is below 0.05 on both assets
sensitivity_rule: M15 and H1 are reported completely but cannot rescue a failed M30 primary; any selected winner becomes a new hypothesis
forbidden: parameter or timeframe selection after outcome inspection
pooling the H4 v1 result with v2
using recent official diagnostic as multi-year evidence
calling TradingView win-loss count ratio a profit factor
placing MT5 orders or pushing a remote
